name: Getting started
description: Shows the first steps in Meno when it first opens, and suggests plugins to add - for a file no plugin added reads, too.

guide.title: Welcome to Meno
guide.text: Double-click on empty space to add something: a bond, a chain, a structure from its SMILES, text or an arrow.

guide.title: Quick Add
guide.text: Press Chain and move: a carbon chain follows the pointer, closing a ring where it comes round. SMILES makes a structure from its SMILES.

guide.title: Hold to select
guide.text: Press and hold on a structure to select all of it. Keep holding and drag to move it.

guide.title: Right-click
guide.text: Right-click anything for what can be done with it. The icons along the top are those used most.

guide.title: Save
guide.text: Save keeps the whole workspace - drawings, molecules in 3D, results - as one .meno file. Settings is beside it.

guide.title: Plugins
guide.text: Meno does more with plugins. These are a good start; each is downloaded only when you add it, after Meno asks.
